rows.name: Alaska State Medical Board
rows.mandate: Licenses and disciplines Alaska's physicians and physician assistants. Eight members appointed by the Governor — five physicians from separate regions, a physician assistant, and two public members (AS 08.64.010).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Alaska Statutes; AK publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Alaska Board of Game
rows.mandate: Sets Alaska's hunting and trapping regulations and wildlife conservation policy. Seven members appointed by the Governor and confirmed by the Legislature, chosen for diversity of interest (AS 16.05.221).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Alaska Statutes; AK publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Alaska Real Estate Commission
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates Alaska's real estate brokers and licensees. Seven members appointed by the Governor — five brokers across the judicial districts and two public members (AS 08.88.011).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Alaska Statutes; AK publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)
